lines: Anupāya unit 31: By these two just, but from causes: not two-natured, nor two-ab
l4.sanskrit_cite: ābhyāmeva tu hetubhyāṃ na dvyātmā na dvayojjhitaḥ sarvātmanā hi bhātyeṣa kena rūpeṇa mantryatām
